evidence: app/package.json:6-8 — no test script, no test runner in devDependencies
app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:44-58 — compareValues (missing-values-last, direction) has no tests
coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests at all; the riskiest logic (sorting, filtering, pagination, URL state, species dedup) is completely uncovered.

behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: No tests exist, so there are no behavioural assertions either.

evidence: app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:285-299 — sorting re-parses rendered DOM text; a markup refactor would silently break it with nothing failing
regression_power.rationale: Nothing would fail on a behaviour break because there is nothing to fail.

evidence: app/src — no test files, so no noise either
signal_to_noise.rationale: Per the rubric, no tests scores 3 on signal-to-noise.

findings.issue: The app ships zero tests despite containing genuinely risky logic (moves-table sorting, home filtering/pagination/URL state, species dedup).
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or node:test) covering app/src/util.ts, compareValues, speciesFromPokemonRefs, and the home filter/pagination state helpers; all are already pure functions extracted for testability, so coverage needs no DOM mocking.

findings.issue: Column sorting derives row data by re-parsing rendered cell textContent with hard-coded offsets and Number()/em-dash parsing, so any change to moveRowHtml markup silently mis-sorts or crashes.
findings.suggestion: Keep the MoveRow[] data in a module-level map keyed by table instead of re-parsing the DOM; unit-test sorting on data rows directly.

findings.issue: Dedup keeps the first-seen entry's is_hidden flag per species; if a species appears first with is_hidden=false and later as hidden, the 'Hidden ability' note is lost.
findings.suggestion: Track hidden as a per-species OR (or prefer the hidden entry), and add a regression test with a species listed twice.

findings.issue: Filter matching, page clamping/slicing, query-string omission and debounced URL replaceState are untested; off-by-one or lost-parameter bugs would ship unnoticed.
findings.suggestion: Extract stateFromParams/queryFor/matches into pure functions and unit-test the round-trip (filters → URL → same filters, page reset, invalid type/generation dropped).

findings.issue: speciesFromPokemonRefs relies on idFromUrl + the id<=10000 boundary + a name fallback (ref name used when the species map misses) that could emit a wrong URL like /pokemon/deoxys-normal.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with refs containing alternate forms (id 10000 vs 10001), duplicates, and out-of-order ids; drop the silent fallback or make it explicit.

findings.issue: Promise-cache eviction and memo reset-on-error retry semantics (app/src/data.ts:12-15) are untested; a caching regression (e.g. caching rejected promises) would serve stale errors forever.
findings.suggestion: Add a small test for cache-hit reuse and re-fetch after failure.

findings.issue: The renderToken race guard (stale async renders overwriting newer ones) has no coverage; removing it would reintroduce flicker/races with nothing failing.
findings.suggestion: Cover with a behaviour test (fast navigation between two slow pages) once a runner exists.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no test script, no test files — despite housing the exact logic most likely to break: DOM-reparsed table sorting, home filtering/pagination/URL state, and species dedup with hidden-ability flags. The code is unusually amenable to unit testing since the risky pieces are pure functions, so adding a small vitest suite would be cheap and high-value. Until then, any refactor of the data layer or move-table markup could silently regress sorting, filtering and card links.

untested.area: Moves-table column sorting (missing-values-last, direction flip, tie-break) — app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:44-58, 285-315
untested.likelyBug: Markup or column-offset change breaks the DOM re-parsing of rows, silently mis-sorting tables or crashing the click handler; missing values could start sorting first in descending order.

untested.area: Home filtering, 48-per-page pagination and URL query state — app/src/pages/home.ts:27-38, 100-139
untested.likelyBug: Off-by-one in page slicing, page not clamped after narrowing filters, or query params not omitted at defaults; search debounce could race and push a stale q into the URL.

untested.area: Species mapping from Pokémon refs: alternate-form exclusion (id<=10000), dedup, dex ordering — app/src/data.ts:85-103, app/src/util.ts:47
untested.likelyBug: A boundary or dedup change leaks Mega forms into lists or drops legit species; the name fallback could emit links to /pokemon/<form name> instead of the species.

untested.area: Hidden-ability flag per species on the ability page — app/src/pages/ability.ts:33-47
untested.likelyBug: First-seen-wins dedup loses the 'Hidden ability' note when a species appears both normally and hidden.

untested.area: Type index derived from type records (slot ordering, dual-slot species) — app/src/data.ts:55-68
untested.likelyBug: Slot sort or membership regression would show a species' types in the wrong order or exclude a species from its second type's filter on /.

untested.area: Text-shaping helpers: latestEnFlavor whitespace collapse, enName, enShortEffect, dexNumber, humanize — app/src/util.ts:12-45
untested.likelyBug: 'Last English entry' assumed in API order; a change to filter/find could pick the first flavor text or emit raw \f characters; dex padding could regress (#25 instead of #0025).

untested.area: Error and not-found paths: ApiError/isNotFound, per-route 404 handling, generic error page, render race token — app/src/api.ts:18-27, app/src/main.ts:16-44
untested.likelyBug: A non-404 failure or a removed isNotFound check could render a blank page or wrong 'Error' title for a missing move/type/ability; losing the renderToken guard reintroduces stale-render flicker.

untested.area: Game select URL sync and default (highest order, ?game= param, param deleted for default) — app/src/pages/pokemon.ts:155-166, 285-292
untested.likelyBug: Invalid ?game= could fall back wrong or leak into the URL; the 'delete param when last option' heuristic breaks if game order changes.

untested.area: Runtime caching semantics: promise cache eviction on failure and memo reset — app/src/api.ts:28-45, app/src/data.ts:12-15
untested.likelyBug: Caching a rejected promise would serve errors forever after a transient API failure.
